campaigns.name: Cite & Deflect
campaigns.objective: signups — drive conversions from support leads frustrated with hallucinating bots
campaigns.big_idea: Position botsmith as the only chatbot that won’t lie to customers. Highlight the citation-enforced accuracy and human escalation guardrails. Target support leaders who’ve faced public trust loss from bot errors.
campaigns.hook: Your support bot shouldn’t guess. If it can’t cite the source, it shouldn’t ship.

sample_copy.headline: Every Answer Shows Its Source — Or It Doesn’t Ship
sample_copy.body: 61% of chats resolved end-to-end. 100% of answers cite their source. Set up in 5 minutes from your sitemap. No hallucinations, ever.

campaigns.why_on_brand: Uses the brand’s confident, trust-focused tone and builds on the key message of citation-enforced accuracy.

campaigns.name: Five-Minute Fix
campaigns.objective: awareness — showcase how fast botsmith deploys
campaigns.big_idea: Run a time-based challenge: 'Can your support bot go live in 5 minutes?' Use real sitemaps to demonstrate setup speed. Target teams drowning in ticket volume.
campaigns.hook: Your next support bot can go live in 5 minutes. No training. No UI babysitting.

sample_copy.headline: Build a Docs-Grounded Support Bot in 5 Minutes
sample_copy.body: Paste your sitemap. Get a citation-enforced chatbot. Embed it. Done. No credit card, no config hell. Just working answers.

campaigns.why_on_brand: Mirrors the brand’s simple, fast, and concrete messaging with second-person empowerment.

campaigns.name: No Hallucination Guarantee
campaigns.objective: trust-building — differentiate from competitors with a bold promise
campaigns.big_idea: Launch a 'No Hallucination Guarantee' campaign with a public pledge: botsmith will never invent an answer. Use visual proof of citations and escalation logs.
campaigns.hook: We guarantee it: no made-up answers. If the doc doesn’t say it, the bot won’t either.

sample_copy.headline: The Only Support Bot With a No-Hallucination Guarantee
sample_copy.body: Every answer cites its source. When confidence is low, it escalates. No guessing. No damage control. Just trust.

campaigns.success_metric: click-through rate to proof points page
campaigns.why_on_brand: Aligns with the brand’s trust-focused voice and avoids overpromising by grounding claims in observed behavior.

campaigns.name: Support Leader Stories
campaigns.objective: community — build credibility through peer narratives
campaigns.big_idea: Feature short interviews or quotes from support leads who’ve faced bot failures. Show how botsmith prevents reputational risk.
campaigns.hook: One wrong bot answer cost us a customer. Now, every reply cites the source.

sample_copy.headline: From Bot Blunder to Bot Confidence
sample_copy.body: Hear from support leaders who switched after a hallucination incident. With botsmith, every answer is grounded — or it escalates.

campaigns.why_on_brand: Uses real proof points and avoids jargon, speaking directly to the ICP in a clear, professional tone.

campaigns.name: Embed the Truth
campaigns.objective: retention — encourage deeper integration and usage
campaigns.big_idea: Encourage users to embed botsmith everywhere — helpdesk, docs, website — with the tagline 'Embed the truth'. Focus on the citation feature as a trust signal.
campaigns.hook: Your docs are your truth. Now your bot can speak it — with proof.

sample_copy.headline: Embed the Truth With Source-Cited Answers
sample_copy.body: Every answer links to the source. No more guessing. No more trust loss. Just clear, cited support.

campaigns.success_metric: number of active embeds per account
campaigns.why_on_brand: Uses the brand’s vocabulary like 'source' and 'no guessing', and maintains a confident, clear tone.

confidence.notes: All campaigns are grounded in the provided BRAND_DNA and APP_PROFILE. No external data was invented.
